name: holmev-master-os
description: H.O.L.M.E.V — Ultimate Multimodal Personal AI Operating System

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/shared-types run typecheck && npm --prefix services/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/desktop-agent run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
